Ticket Id: 195543

Dr B Comber
Urologist
Southport Hospital
Gold Coast

01 June 2010

Dear Dr Comber

Re: Mr Tom Cribb
DOB: 23/05/1982

Thank you for seeing Mr Tom Cribb, a 28-year-old builder’s labourer who has an ectopic kidney along
with hypronephrosis, for further investigation and assessment.

Mr Cribb smokes 5-6 cigarettes daily and drinks 2-5 units weekly. He has no known allergies. His mother     Comment [OET1]: in a week
died of breast cancer, and his father has hypertension.

Mr Cribb presented on 12/05/2010, with acute pain in the right lower abdomen, which radiated to the
groin, and nausea. However, he denied any urinary changes or associated symptoms. Examination
revealed mild lower abdominal tenderness. At that time, he was diagnosed with ureteric colic, prescribed    Comment [OET2]: and was
diclofenac sodium 50 mg twice daily, and advised to increase his fluid intake and to exercise regularly.    Comment [OET3]: . He was

Two days later, he was asymptomatic. An IVP revealed an ectopic, enlarged right kidney but the left         Comment [OET4]: Mr Cribb
kidney was normal, with no evidence of stones. Microscopic hematouria was detected by a UFR.

Today, Mr Cribb reported mild right lower abdominal pain, which responded to Panadol. A hard mass in
the right lower quadrant was found on DRE. His BP was 140/90. An ultrasound detected severe
hydronephrosis and a liver mass. Please note, Mr Cribb will return to work in two weeks.                    Comment [OET5]: has been unemployed
                                                                                                            for some time and is due to start
Kindly arrange for a CT scan as you see appropriate and assess Mr Cribb’s condition and provide a CT        Comment [OET6]: In view of the above,
scan, if needed.                                                                                            please


Should there be any queries, please do not hesitate to contact me.

Yours sincerely

Doctor.




                                                    Report
    Word Length                207
    Comments                   The letter has only a few inaccuracies pertaining to word choice
                               and grammar. The purpose is clear. However, some parts can be
                               developed in a better way. Overall, the letter meets the
                               expectations.
    Estimated Grade            B
    Estimated Score            390/500
    Advice                     1. Improve coherence/paragraphing.
                               2. Always proofread the letter after finishing it.
